coarse_between_head_layer_spearman.statistic: spearman(mean d_B^local per (layer,head), mean Tier-B KL per (layer,head))

fine_within_head_spearman.statistic: median over strata of spearman(d_B^local, Tier-B KL) within each (layer,head)

interpretation: Coarse (between-head/layer) and fine (within-head block-ranking) predictive power are reported separately and must not be pooled into one statistic. EXPLORATORY -- not a frozen preregistration.
